name: Dataflows - New Destination: HTML Document
description: We plan to introduce HTML Document as a new data destination for Dataflow Gen2, enabling customers to turn data prepared in Microsoft Fabric into shareable, browser-friendly documents using the low-code Power Query experience. Designed for citizen users, this destination meets business teams where they are today—with content they can open, read, and share in familiar tools. It bridges the gap between preparing data and communicating results, without requiring a separate reporting solution to make those results accessible.Key benefits and scenarios:* Make prepared data accessible: Deliver dataflow results as HTML documents that colleagues and stakeholders can view in a web browser.* Simplify everyday communication: Create data-driven business summaries and operational updates for teams that work primarily with documents.* Reduce repetitive work: Generate document outputs when the dataflow runs, rather than manually copying query results into separate documents. During Preview, customers can evaluate HTML document generation for their everyday workflows and provide feedback to help refine the experience.

result.descriptionEs: Dataflow Gen2 podrá generar documentos HTML a partir de datos preparados en Fabric, pensados para usuarios de negocio que quieran compartir resultados fáciles de abrir en un navegador, sin una solución de informes aparte. Estará disponible en Preview.
